forest-ink.$description: Forest Ink — Primary action buttons, headings, links, icon strokes — deep botanical green reads as ink, the only saturated dark in the system

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Mid-tone card backgrounds and decorative washes, panel-level surfaces

keylime-wash.$description: Keylime Wash — Hero panel background, light card surfaces — the dominant tinted canvas tone

mint-veil.$description: Mint Veil — Accent card surfaces, soft section dividers between sage and keylime layers

slate-hush.$description: Slate Hush — Cool counter-balance panel for product preview and feature blocks — breaks the green monotony with desaturated blue-gray

cream-paper.$description: Cream Paper — Page background, badge backgrounds, button text — warm off-white that softens every green

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Navigation text and minor UI strokes — restrained secondary ink

border-mist.$description: Border Mist — Hairline dividers and subtle borders throughout the layout

forest-shadow.$description: Forest Shadow — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

faire-octave.$description: Display serif for all section headings and hero copy

suisse-intl.$description: Body, navigation, UI labels, buttons, captions — humanist sans at whisper weight for feature lists and normal weight for copy
